description: Writes a valid SizeRef chart v1 as SizeRef JSON, schema.org JSON-LD, CSV and plain text, and lists anything left out and why. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 64 characters a size label or measurement name; each table cell is read up to 200 characters. jsonld is a whole <script type="application/ld+json"> block, ready to paste into the product page, with its JSON escaped so no value can end the block. jsonld_note says how the theme can link each variant size to the matching @id; that step is optional.
name: export_agent_ready_chart
title: Export a size chart
